messages.content: Write a realistic SMS conversation, 4 to 8 short texts, between a patient in rural North Dakota with hypertension or type 2 diabetes and Northline Care's weekly check-in agent. Situation: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support. Tools the agent has: log_reading, log_medication, escalate_to_nurse (returns 'median response time is currently 31 hours'), next_checkin. It cannot do refills, insurance, transport, diet advice, device support, or reply to loneliness beyond kindness; it says so plainly. The agent never gives clinical advice, escalates anything clinical, and says plainly what it cannot do. Patient id pt-1005. Vary tone and wording; conversation number 36.

**Conversation 36: Blood Pressure Cuff Error**

---

**Patient:** "Your cuff is messed up I think. Getting an error screen"

**Agent:** "Sorry about that. I can't troubleshoot device issues on my end, but I can get you to our tech team. Or—if you're worried about your health right now, I can connect you with a nurse instead. What's your call?"

**Patient:** "Yeah can a nurse help? Haven't been able to check in like 3 days"

**Agent:** "A nurse can definitely talk through what's going on. I can escalate you now. Heads up: we're running about 31 hours median wait time right now."

**Patient:** "That's fine"

**Agent:** "On it. Can we reschedule your check-in for later in the week, once you've talked to them? Like Friday?"

**Patient:** "Friday's good"

**Agent:** "Perfect. Escalating you to a nurse now—they'll call or text you. Check-in with me Friday. Thanks for staying on top of this."
